mechanics.fact: Freezer temperatures soared to 50C as the hack flipped cooling to heating
mechanics.mechanic: Synchronized heat-flip gates: full-height coil beams across the aisles share one broadcast clock (1400ms hot / 1400ms cold, all gates flip simultaneously), the coils themselves the tell; melt drips intensify per aisle as the freezers fail

mechanics.fact: Obsolete control systems with internet-exposed interfaces were exploited remotely
mechanics.mechanic: Hacked Defroster drones (freezer-fan units with glowing heater coils) patrol every aisle on x/y lanes; the seized machines are placed mid-route where the player must cross their lanes

mechanics.fact: 10 countries hit, shelves emptied, restock crews replenishing stores
mechanics.mechanic: Supply-chain switchback topology: climb three emptied freezer aisles as stair set-pieces, cross the gantry traverse, take the roof control-room crown; checkpoints are restock depots and aisle adds (compactor, Defrosters, melt lines) escalate per aisle

mechanics.fact: Belgium hardest-hit with dozens of stores failing at once
mechanics.mechanic: Finale vault: a doubled coil pair on one shared cold window plus melt drips plus a patrolling vault guard on the crown deck — the worst-hit store with all pressure at once
